rawContent: So much love and respect for Iesha and Dravon. My hometown (Phoenix) has a record of having some of the worst police brutality in the country. Last year (2018) Phx PD had the worst use of deadly force in the nation. Grateful for their courage and leadership. #BlackLivesMatter

A report released earlier this year shows that Phoenix, Arizona had the most officer-involved shootings in the country. More than double the number it had in 2017. #PhoenixPD #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/pFsNeJKLb5

Today marks 6 years since the inception of #blacklivesmatter. It’s a day filled with pain as Sandra Bland died in a jail cell on this day, but it’s also a day where the seeds of resilience began to blossom. And countless people and organizations chose to do something different.
